descTh: From novel to webtoon and now an anime, the Solo Leveling series has captured the world’s attention. In Crunchyroll’s exclusive two-part documentary, we go back to the beginning to meet the architects of the global phenomenon. Get a behind-the-scenes look with Seoul’s D&C Media and Redice Studio creators, Aniplex, and A-1 Pictures at how the highly anticipated series came to life.
